body_markdown:
**SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. – August 20** **, 2026 –** ****[StandardAero](https://standardaero.com/) (NYSE: SARO), a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) and engine component repair, has expanded airframe maintenance services for its business aviation customers at its[Van Nuys, Calif. (VNY) facility](https://standardaero.com/aboutus/locations/van-nuys-ca/) to support select[Bombardier Global aircraft](https://bombardier.com/en/corporate-fleet-global-family) maintenance and modifications.


StandardAero’s Van Nuys airframe MRO facility specializes in long-range business jets, having supported[Gulfstream](https://standardaero.com/airframe/gulfstream/) operators from the site for more than 25 years. StandardAero’s Van Nuys repair station authorization adds airframe inspection, repair, structures, and avionics capability for the Bombardier Global Express, Global Express XRS, Global 5000, Global 6000 and Global 7500 models. Worldwide, the Bombardier Global fleet represents more than 1,200 delivered aircraft, with more than 600 in North America.


“Our Van Nuys site has decades of Gulfstream MRO experience, and we’re excited to enhance our service offering by adding another large cabin aircraft with the Global family by investing further in our current team and in tooling to support these aircraft,” said Giovanni Spitale, President of StandardAero Business Aviation.


StandardAero has already begun supporting Global operators at VNY, including inspections and repair events, SpaceX Starlink installations on Global 5000 aircraft, BR710 engine line maintenance and support for a multi-aircraft Global fleet operator. The company is a Rolls-Royce authorized service center for BR710 engines that power most of the Global family. StandardAero performs BR710 line maintenance on-site at Van Nuys and through StandardAero’s Mobile Service Team (MST) for in-field support.


“Our customers want a trusted maintenance partner that can support the entire aircraft,” said Roland Scensnovic, Vice President and General Manager of StandardAero’s Van Nuys facility. “With airframe, avionics, engine, structures and interior capabilities all under one roof and across our network, we’re continuing to build that CompleteCare®, comprehensive support solution for Global operators.”


StandardAero’s Van Nuys facility supports aircraft operators under FAA, EASA, AFAC and TCCA approvals and is strategically located at one of the world’s busiest business aviation airports. In addition to VNY, StandardAero also supports maintenance and modifications for Bombardier Global aircraft at its Springfield, IL (SPI) facility, where the company provides FAA ODA and engineering services.


###


**StandardAero** is a leading independent pure-play provider of aerospace engine aftermarket services for fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft, serving the commercial, military and business aviation end markets. StandardAero provides a comprehensive suite of critical, value-added aftermarket solutions, including engine maintenance, repair and overhaul, engine component repair, on-wing and field service support, asset management and engineering solutions. StandardAero is an NYSE listed company under the ticker symbol SARO.
